full_name: INEGI Censo de Poblacion y Vivienda 2020, Cuestionario Ampliado -- Movilidad cotidiana, tabulado 22 (modo o medio de traslado al lugar de trabajo, por municipio)
description: Employed persons aged 12+ who travel to work, estimated from the extended-questionnaire sample, and the share using each means of transport (a person may report several, so the shares add to more than 100 %). Counts = estimated commuters x published percentage, i.e. persons using the mode; the transit share of the pipeline is mentions of public transport over mentions of public transport, private vehicle, walking and cycling. Published per municipality only.

features.original_name: Poblacion de 12 anos y mas ocupada que se traslada al lugar de trabajo
features.definition: Employed persons 12+ who travel to their place of work (estimate).

features.original_name: Camion, autobus, combi, colectivo o taxi
features.definition: Workers using a bus, minibus (combi), shared taxi (colectivo) or taxi, including Metro / BRT trips reported as such, to go to work.
Workers using a private vehicle (car, van, motorcycle) to go to work.
Workers using another means (Metro, light rail, Metrobus and similar are reported here in some states, transport of personnel, etc.).
